map.→ 打开文案朗读时长工具: -> Open the script reading duration tool
map.中文为主、夹英文品牌词的文案，分别计中文字与英文词，避免时长算错。: Copy that is mostly Chinese with English brand words mixed in: count Chinese characters and English words separately so the duration is not wrong.
map.中文按'字/分钟'、英文按'词/分钟'分别计更准（英文词普遍比中文字占用更久）。: Count Chinese by 'characters per minute' and English by 'words per minute' separately for better accuracy (an English word generally takes longer than a Chinese character). In mixed text, count each separately and add them up, which is closer to real reading than estimating from a single character count.
map.中英文混排时长怎么算？: How is the duration of mixed Chinese/English copy calculated?
map.在句段间留出停顿（如标点到停），让总时长更贴近真实录制。: Leave pauses between segments (for example at punctuation) so the total duration is closer to a real recording.
map.广告口播、短视频配音前，按语速估算文案朗读秒数，卡准 15 秒/30 秒版本。: Before an ad read or a short-video voiceover, estimate the reading seconds of the copy from the speech rate to hit the 15-second or 30-second cut.
map.慢速（新闻播报）约 180–200 字/分，正常（标准朗读）约 240–260: Slow (news reading) is about 180-200 characters/min, normal (standard reading) about 240-260 characters/min, and fast (ad voiceover) 300+ characters/min. Actual recording is affected by emotion and phrasing, so calibrate against a sample of the final cut; this tool gives a theoretical estimate.
map.文案朗读时长估算器，根据字数与语速(字/分钟)估算配音、广告或演讲朗读时长，便于: The script reading duration estimator computes the reading time of a voiceover, ad or speech from the word count and speech rate (characters per minute), which helps scheduling and pacing.
map.语速档位怎么选？: How do I choose a speech rate tier?
map.：中文文案 120 字，语速选'正常（标准朗读）'250 字/分 → 朗读 12: : a 120-character Chinese script at a "normal (standard reading)" rate of 250 characters/min -> 120/250x60 ≈ 28.8 seconds of reading; adding three 1-second pauses gives about 31.8 seconds, which just fits a 30-35 second voiceover slot.
